## Checklist

- [ ] I dedicate this menu to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), and I have the right to do so.
- [ ] It contains **no studio artwork, music or video**, and refers to none by link.
- [ ] I wrote or properly edited this menu: its labels are real names, not a file's name or an unedited draft.
- [ ] The file is `menus/<movie|tv>/<TMDB id>/<menuId>.menu.json` with a `<menuId>.listing.json` beside it.
- [ ] I changed an existing menu: its `revision` went up and the listing's `changelog` says what changed.
- [ ] `python3 tools/catalogue_check.py --plugin <plugin checkout>` passes on my machine (or I will fix whatever CI reports).
